question: Mariani avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
There is no major corporate parent company or widely known commercial brand named "Mariani Avocado Oil." You might be thinking of **Marianne's** (or Marianne's Harvest), an independent purveyor of specialty cold-pressed and propellant-free avocado oils and sprays, or you may be conflating it with **Mariani Packing Company** (a family-owned dried fruit brand) or **Chosen Foods** (a major pioneer and brand in the avocado oil space). [](https://medium.com/authority-magazine/mark-mariani-of-mariani-packing-company-5-things-you-need-to-run-a-highly-successful-family-e80308edf16c)

-   **Marianne's / Marianne's Harvest:** Operates as an independent, family-oriented maker of pure and organic high-heat avocado oils.

-   **Mariani Packing Company:** A prominent, independent family-owned dried fruit and snack processing company based in Vacaville, California, founded in 1906, which occasionally features recipes utilizing avocado oil but does not own an avocado oil subsidiary. [](https://mariani.com/blogs/salads/grain-free-grilled-shrimp-and-pineapple-power-bowls)

-   **Mariani Nut Company:** A separate family-and-cousin-founded California agricultural processor (walnuts, almonds, pecans) established in 1972, also independent.

If you meant a specific brand name or saw a label with a different spelling, please share the **exact product name** or **store where you found it** so I can identify the correct owner for you.
